name: Collapsible detail card
definition: Card that hides depth until it is clicked open.
bestUse: Async readers who choose their depth.

demo.how: Each card shows only a one-line finding and a chevron. Play opens the first card to reveal its evidence, then closes it and opens the second, so readers choose their depth. The cards are also real buttons: click or press Enter on any card to open or close it.
